function.name: memory_store
function.description: Remember a durable factual memory for the long term (e.g. a concrete user/device fact, operational preference, or standing commitment). Do not use this for assistant persona, assistant identity, or editable user profile documents.

content.description: The fact to remember, written concisely in the third person.

tags.description: Short topic labels to file this memory under (e.g. "preference", "device", "fact"). You recall by these labels later.

keywords.description: Optional extra search terms that need not appear in the content.
